title: Norway Nears Goal to Sell only Electric New Cars
titleZh: 挪威接近实现仅销售全新电动汽车的目标
credits: Pierre-Henry Deshayes reported this story for Agence France-Presse. Jill Robbins adapted it for Learning English.

sentences.en: Norway is very close to meeting its goal of selling only fully electric new vehicles starting this year.
sentences.zh: 挪威非常接近从今年起只销售纯电动新车的目标。

sentences.en: The Norwegian Road Federation (OFV), an automotive industry group, estimates that nearly 96 percent of new cars registered in Norway in January were all-electric.
sentences.zh: 挪威道路联合会（OFV）是一家汽车行业协会，据其估计，1月挪威注册的新车中近96%为纯电动。

sentences.en: No other country has such a high rate of electric car (EV) ownership.
sentences.zh: 没有任何国家拥有如此高的电动汽车（EV）拥有率。

sentences.en: The OFV noted that of the 9,343 new cars sold last month in Norway, 8,954 of them were all-electric.
sentences.zh: OFV指出，在上月挪威销售的9343辆新车中，8954辆为纯电动。

sentences.en: Of the 50 most-sold models, only two were non-electric.
sentences.zh: 在销量最高的50款车型中，只有两款为非电动车。

sentences.en: The first of those came in 33rd place among the 50 models, the federation said.
sentences.zh: 该联合会称，其中一款在这50款车型中排名第33位。

sentences.en: The European Automobile Manufacturers’ Association (ACEA) reported the share of electric cars in Europe was just 13.6 percent during 2024.
sentences.zh: 欧洲汽车制造商协会（ACEA）报告称，2024年欧洲电动车的占比仅为13.6%。

sentences.en: That was the first recorded decrease since 2020.
sentences.zh: 这是自2020年以来首次有记录的下降。

sentences.en: OFV director Oyvind Solberg Thorsen said in a statement, "We've never seen this before...If the rest of the year continues like this, we will very soon be close to the 2025 goal."
sentences.zh: OFV董事Oyvind Solberg Thorsen在一份声明中表示：'我们从未见过这样的情况……如果今年其余时间都保持这样的势头，我们很快就会接近2025年的目标。'

sentences.en: He noted that reaching 100 percent of the goal means to continue to offer the “incentives that make it profitable to choose an electric car over other models.”
sentences.zh: 他指出，要实现100%的目标，就需要继续提供'让选择电动车比其他车型更划算的激励措施。'

sentences.en: Even though it is a major oil and gas producer, Norway aims to only sell "zero emission" new vehicles starting in 2025.
sentences.zh: 尽管挪威是主要的石油和天然气生产国，但仍力争从2025年起只销售'零排放'新车。

sentences.en: That goal is 10 years ahead of the target set by the European Union (EU).
sentences.zh: 这一目标比欧盟（EU）设定的目标提前了10年。

sentences.en: Norway is not a member of the EU.
sentences.zh: 挪威不是欧盟成员国。

sentences.en: One difference between the EU and Norway’s method is that Norway has not banned the sale of cars with engines that burn fuel.
sentences.zh: 欧盟与挪威在做法上的一个区别在于，挪威并未禁止销售燃油车。

sentences.en: Instead, Norway offers a number of tax breaks to EV manufacturers and owners.
sentences.zh: 相反，挪威为电动车制造商和车主提供多项税收优惠。

sentences.en: On the other hand, the country heavily taxes gas-powered vehicles.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，该国对燃油车课以重税。

sentences.en: For example, Norwegian EV owners do not have to pay road tolls and receive free parking in public car parks.
sentences.zh: 例如，挪威的电动车主无需支付道路通行费，并在公共停车场享受免费停车。

sentences.en: EVs are also permitted to use parts of roads normally saved for public transportation vehicles.
sentences.zh: 电动车还被允许使用通常仅供公共交通工具使用的部分道路。

sentences.en: While some tax breaks and incentives have been reduced over the years, EVs have still kept expanding across Norwegian roads.
sentences.zh: 尽管一些税收优惠和激励措施多年来有所削减，但电动车在挪威的道路上仍在不断扩展。

sentences.en: Frode Hvattum is a 50-year-old father of three who owns two EVs.
sentences.zh: Frode Hvattum是一名50岁的三孩父亲，他拥有两辆电动车。

sentences.en: He told the French News Agency AFP he started buying EVs because of his concern for the environment and for the benefits of driving them.
sentences.zh: 他向法国法新社（AFP）表示，他开始购买电动车是出于对环境的担忧以及驾驶它们所带来的好处。

sentences.en: He lives in an area near Oslo where the streets are full of Teslas, Audis and Volkswagens.
sentences.zh: 他住在奥斯格附近的一个地区，那里的街道上到处都是特斯拉、奥迪和大众汽车。

sentences.en: Some less costly Chinese EVs are increasingly appearing too.
sentences.zh: 一些较为便宜的中国电动车也越来越常见。

sentences.en: Many homes have a device to charge, or supply electricity to, their EV’s battery.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭都装有为电动车电池充电或供电的设备。

sentences.en: Norway also has a large national network of superfast charging stations.
sentences.zh: 挪威还拥有覆盖全国的高速充电站网络。

sentences.en: Having a nationwide charging network was important for Hvattum, who, like many Norwegians, often travels by car to his second home in the mountains several hours outside Oslo.
sentences.zh: 对赫瓦特姆来说，拥有全国性的充电网络十分重要，他和许多挪威人一样，经常开车前往奥斯陆数小时外的山中第二居所。

sentences.en: He said he finds it easy to plan and make trips with numerous charging stations available.
sentences.zh: 他说，由于充电站众多，他很容易就能规划并出行。

sentences.en: "You don't have to plan your trip as much as before," Hvattum said.
sentences.zh: 赫瓦特姆说：'你不必像从前那样花那么多心思规划行程。'

sentences.en: He added that he uses the 15-to-20-minute charging breaks his vehicle needs to make it up to the mountains to shop for food.
sentences.zh: 他还补充说，他利用车辆需要充电的15到20分钟休息时间，顺便采购食物，一路开到山里。

sentences.en: Even if EV sales fail to meet the 100 percent mark this year, experts say Norway can still be seen as having met its goal.
sentences.zh: 即使今年电动车销量未能达到100%的目标，专家仍认为挪威可以被视为已经实现了其目标。

sentences.en: Christina Bu heads the Norwegian Electric Vehicle Association.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·布是挪威电动车协会的主管。

sentences.en: She told AFP, "We should finish the year at between 95 and 100 percent."
sentences.zh: 她告诉法新社：'我们今年应该能完成95%到100%的目标。'

sentences.en: I’m Jill Robbins.
sentences.zh: 我是吉尔·罗宾斯。
